BL-536 — Detect provider auth errors in pane scrollback and auto-respawn with compat env
What it solves: WHAT / WHY: classify-provider-error already maps Invalid API key → :auth,
and provider_compat_lib/provider-auth-error-text? exists, but nothing in
handoffd/ensure observes pane scrollback for auth and heals.
